citation: Tsukamoto H, et al. Sci Rep 2023;13:21337
protocol: Study 1: two 20-min bouts of moderate-intensity aerobic cycling at 60% VO2peak (about 148 W) separated by 20 min; HR and RPE in Table 1; glucose and lactate before and after in text
population: 20 men, 21 +/- 2 y (study 1); studies 2 and 3 have 11 and 12 men
note: Some blood values are median (IQR); lactate and glucose time courses are mostly in figures, text gives baseline and end values.
